name: Otonashi Shizuko
source:
Serves as the Music teacher. She is also the advisor for the Drama club. She has an unusual personality, and is seen practicing her acting performances while hanging upside down. Before becoming a teacher, she had aspired to be an opera singer.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
